outcomes.comparator_recovered_2026_08_18: RECOVERED FROM THIS OBJECT'S OWN PROSE, not invented: the title and question name 'olmesartan medoxomil plus hydrochlorothiazide' as the comparator. The field was null while the page described an active comparison. AND THE NULL WAS LOAD-BEARING, not cosmetic -- build_app_v2.py line 997 reads outcome["comparator"] through an escape function that raises on None, so this page could not have been rebuilt while it stood. Found by scripts/internal_consistency_gate.py, specified from a defect an outside review found on a different object.

sbp_change_wk8.estimator_authority: Cochrane Handbook 6.5 (2024) section 10.10.4.4 -- REML is RevMan's current default. Applied corpus-wide on 2026-08-18.

heterogeneity.tau2_estimator: REML (restricted maximum likelihood) -- copied from this block's declared `estimator`, which is the authoritative record of how the pool was computed. NOT inferred: an object that declared no estimator would be left undeclared here, because the absence is itself the finding.
heterogeneity.i2_definition: UNDECIDABLE from this object. I-squared is 0 and Q is below the degrees of freedom, where the Higgins form is negative-and-clamped and the REML/metafor form is exactly zero -- BOTH DEFINITIONS GIVE 0 and nothing here distinguishes them. Recorded as undecidable rather than guessed.

sbp_change_wk8.poolable_reason: BOTH VALUES ARE READ from the registries' own posted ANCOVA analyses. THE TOPIC IS RENAMED, and the rename is the point. The page it replaces was titled 'azilsartan in hypertension' over FOUR trials with THREE different comparators -- one of which compared azilsartan against ITSELF on a different partner diuretic. Four trials, three questions. These two share BOTH arms and are the only coherent contrast in that set, so the page is named for the contrast it actually answers. MULTI-ARM HANDLING, stated because it changes the number: each trial randomised TWO azilsartan dose ranges against ONE olmesartan arm. Taking both contrasts would double-count the shared control. ONE contrast per trial is used -- the 20-40 mg range, which is the dose range both trials share -- and the higher range (-6.7 and -6.9) is recorded but not pooled.
sbp_change_wk8.small_k_interval_note: Handbook 6.5 sections 10.10.4.4-10.10.4.5: with two or three studies a sensitivity comparison of interval methods is advised. Hartung-Knapp is not adopted as the primary interval here; the corpus rule is that it is reported as a sensitivity analysis at k<=3.
sbp_change_wk8.what_this_does_not_establish: NOT that the trials are free of bias -- no RoB-2 assessment is recorded on this object. NOT that the pooled value transfers outside the populations these trials enrolled. NOT that the registry's posted analysis is itself correct: it is READ, and reading it faithfully is a different claim from endorsing it.

multi_arm_contrast_not_pooled.why: The higher azilsartan dose range against the same olmesartan arm. Pooling both contrasts from one trial would double-count the shared control, so one contrast per trial is used and this one is recorded rather than combined.

sbp_change_wk8.poolable_DEPRECATED_note: `poolable` MEANT ONLY 'the source page pooled these trials'. It was never a judgement that the pool was sound, and the renderer read it as permission to assert 'pooled on the X scale'. RENAMED to source_page_pooled, which is what it says. `poolable` is retained so nothing breaks, and it is DEPRECATED: read source_page_pooled for what the source did, and estimand_established for whether the pool is defensible. A PAGE SHOULD DISPLAY A POOLED ESTIMATE BECAUSE ITS ESTIMAND WAS ESTABLISHED, NOT BECAUSE SOMEONE ONCE POOLED IT.
sbp_change_wk8.estimand_established_means: TRUE only where every contributing trial has been READ and shown to measure the same quantity, or the same construct with a variance stated. FALSE where that was checked and failed. NULL where it was never checked -- AN ABSENT ASSERTION AND A NEGATIVE ONE ARE DIFFERENT STATES and null is not a pass.

eligible_but_not_contributing.converted_note: Held a LIST where the generator reads blk.get("studies") -- a mapping with a studies sequence. Entries preserved unchanged under studies. A SHAPE THE CONSUMER CANNOT READ IS THE SAME DEFECT AS A FIELD IT CANNOT FIND.

display_change_announced.what_changed: `heterogeneity.i2` and `heterogeneity.tau2` are field names that each map to more than one standard definition. Every number is unchanged; each now carries the definition it holds. tau2's definition was already recoverable from the declared `estimator` beside it and is copied, never inferred. i2's was not recoverable and is DECIDED BY RECOMPUTING BOTH FORMS from this object's own per-trial inputs, with the evidence recorded.
display_change_announced.why: A reader recomputing Higgins I-squared from the Q printed beside it would have concluded the object was wrong -- and would have been behaving exactly as we want readers to behave. An ambiguous label on an unambiguous number is a defect specifically against the only reader we claim to serve.
